integrity: Integral Morse boundary with unit minor and exhaustive directed-Hasse acyclicity check support the homotopy claim. An independently written mod-two calculation checks combinatorics/homology, not integral homotopy. No external independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: One finite 24-vertex chiral Archimedean graph only; no theorem for all Archimedean graphs or higher-dimensional snub analogues. Unindexed prior computations remain possible.
title: The snub cubical independence complex is a wedge of twenty-six four-spheres
